hooks.command: gh issue list --state open --json number,title,labels,milestone --template '{{range .}}#{{.number}} {{.title}} [{{range .labels}}{{.name}} {{end}}]{{"\n"}}{{end}}' 2>/dev/null | head -40 || echo 'No open issues or gh not authenticated.'

command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "clang-format hook: jq not found — cannot read hook input" >&2; exit 2; }; file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$file" in */JUCE/*) exit 0 ;; *.cpp|*.h|*.hpp|*.mm) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; bash "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/skills/run-lint/lint.sh" format-file "$file" || { echo "clang-format hook: FAILED on $file — formatting was NOT applied (see error above)" >&2; exit 2; }

command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "protected-path guard: jq not found — cannot inspect the write target; BLOCKING (fail closed)" >&2; exit 2; }; file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.notebook_path // empty') || { echo "protected-path guard: unparseable hook payload; BLOCKING (fail closed)" >&2; exit 2; }; case "$file" in "") echo "protected-path guard: payload carried no file_path or notebook_path, so the write target cannot be checked against the protected patterns; BLOCKING (fail closed). If a new tool shape needs supporting, extend this hook in .claude/settings.json." >&2; exit 2 ;; *.env*|*secret*|*credential*|*Signing.entitlements|*.lock|*-lock.*) echo "Protected file: $file" >&2; exit 2 ;; esac; exit 0
